description.blurb: 1566 Icarus is an extremely eccentric asteroid, approximately 1.4 km (0.87 mi) in diameter.
description.more: It is a near-Earth object and potentially hazardous, but has a closest possible intersection with Earth at 13.7 lunar distances, or 13.7 times the distance from the Earth to the moon. In 1968 it became the first asteroid ever observed by radar.
